The framework `Concept` type is defined in `openmrs-esm-core` and re-exported through `@openmrs/esm-framework`. Only two declarations in the patient chart import it from the framework. Most other `Concept` hits in the chart are the app's own local interfaces, so a change in core would not reach them.

**Declarations in the chart that use the framework `Concept`, best first:**

1. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-common-lib/src/orders/postOrders.ts:131-135`: `ObsPayload` types `concept: Concept | string` for observations sent when posting an encounter. This is the write path most exposed to a change in `Concept`.
2. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-common-lib/src/orders/postOrders.ts:146-149`: `postEncounter` posts the `EncounterPost` built from those observation payloads.
3. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-generic-patient-widgets-app/src/obs-table-horizontal/obs-table-horizontal.component.tsx:269-278`: `HorizontalTableProps` takes `concepts: Array<Concept>`, which drives the horizontal obs table.
4. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-generic-patient-widgets-app/src/obs-table-horizontal/obs-table-horizontal.component.tsx:376-384`: the cell component's props also take `concepts: Array<Concept>`.

**Definition in core:** `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-api/src/types/concept-resource.ts:4-18`. Its fields (`name`, `conceptClass`, `datatype`, `mappings`, `answers`, `setMembers`) are what the chart code reads.

**Not affected:** the chart's `Concept` types in `esm-patient-tests-app`, `esm-patient-notes-app`, `esm-form-entry-app`, `esm-patient-common-lib/src/orders/types`, and `esm-patient-chart-app` are local copies. The tests app's `usePanelData.tsx` and `helper.tsx` also use its local types. A change in the core interface would not affect them.

This is based on Falkon reference search, with the import check done by regex over the chart's import blocks. I did not check runtime call sites in `esm-generic-patient-widgets-app` beyond the prop declarations.
